brill_guard: Deathguard of Brill, west gate. Beyond it are the Tirisfal glades and, further on, Deathknell, where the newly risen come up. The dead on that road are not all ours. If you're going out, I've got work that needs doing on the way.
brill_farmer: Nettles. I farmed these fields alive and I farm them dead - habits die harder than people do, it turns out. The duskbats come down on the rows at night, and there's little enough growing as it is.
brill_gravedigger: Hollis, gravedigger of Brill - that's the yard, behind me. The work's slower now that most of what I bury gets up again. Worse, the gnolls have learned to dig, and they aren't particular about whose grave it is.
brill_apothecary_asst: Grael. I assist at the Brill Apothecarium, which means I carry crates and I'm not told what's in them. What I am told is what they've run out of, and it's a long list.
brill_town_crier: Wexley, town crier. Hear ye: the Dark Lady's will is the will of the Forsaken; the zeppelin from Orgrimmar may or may not be running; and the well needs fixing again. I report the news. Lately I've had to send people to find it.
brill_newly_risen_farmhand: Joss. I worked the Balnir farm, east of here, when I was alive. I still remember planting it - funny what the mind keeps, after. I haven't been back. I'm not sure I want to see it myself.
brill_human_sympathizer: Meryl Ashdown. Yes, I'm alive, and no, I'm not leaving. My sister is one of the Forsaken now, and I stayed so that somebody still calls her by her name. My brother made a different choice. He joined the Crusade.
brill_beltelf_trader: Ilvessa, of Silvermoon. More of the reagent trade runs through Brill than anyone admits, and I run a fair share of it - when my cargo arrives. This month some of it didn't.
brill_bell_ringer: Ohmsted. I ring the bell at Brill - not for worship any more, only to mark the hours. I ring it for the dead too, when they're ours. The ones in Brightwater Lake and the Weeping Pond have never had their toll.
brill_scarecrow_tender: Pruit. I keep the scarecrows on the south fields. They scare the crows well enough. It's the rotting dead wandering in off the glades that don't scare so easy.
brill_deathguard: Deathguard Rennick, commanding the Brill watch. Worgs have come down on the Balnir farm to the east, the Nightmare Vale's stirring to the south-west, and I have six guards. Report to me if you want to be useful.
brill_flight_master: Mirren, bat handler. They're fed, saddled, and only mildly hungry for you. I fly to anywhere you've walked to before - name it.
ct_brill: Bleak. I train every discipline in Brill. What you were in life matters less than what you do now - show me, and bring coin.
pt_brill_forge: Mirela. Mining and smithing, both halves - no sense knowing where to dig if you can't do anything with it. The town forge is just east of me.
pt_brill_herbs: Apothecary Bleak. Herbalism and alchemy. I'll show you which plant to pull and what to do with it after, and the second part is where people go wrong. Often fatally, in this town.
pt_brill_wood: Veyra. Woodcutting and woodworking - fell it, saw it, make something of it. Brill's sawmill is across town, by the forge on the south-east side.
pt_brill_hide: Aldous, tanner. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring and cooking all cross my bench, and I'll teach you the lot. A skinner who throws the meat away goes hungry holding a full pack.
pt_brill_essence: Verity. Engineering: metal, a crystal out of an ore vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and we'll see about the third.
